props.name: children
props.comment: Rendered only once authenticated (never during the pending window).

props.name: enabled
props.comment: Whether to enforce the check (default true). `false` → a no-op pass.

props.name: loading
props.comment: Shown while the check is pending (default: nothing).

props.name: logoutOnFailure
props.comment: On a failed check, log the user out (default true) vs. render nothing.
